name: Lifting Wings
body:
You have strengthened your weak wings.

Prerequisite: Walker racial trait, wyvaran

Benefit: You now have a Fly speed of 15 with a maneuverability of clumsy.

Normal: Wyvarans with the walker racial trait can only glide and do not have a fly speed.
